name: rosetta-safe-primes-and-unsafe-primes
code:
use default

let sieve_limit = 10_000_000
let composite = LIST(sieve_limit)

(0..sieve_limit) |> each(_ => composite.add(false))

for candidate in 2..sieve_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= sieve_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple < sieve_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

is_prime(value: int) -> bool => value >= 2 /\ !composite[value]

is_safe(prime: int) -> bool => is_prime((prime - 1) / 2)

selected(wanted: (int) -> bool) -> Pipe[int] =>
    (2..sieve_limit) |> filter(is_prime) |> filter(wanted)

report(name: string, wanted: (int) -> bool, first: int) is
    write_line("first {first} {name} primes:")
    write_line("  {selected(wanted) |> take(first) |> join(" ")}")

    for bound in [1_000_000, 10_000_000] do
        let total =
            selected(wanted)
                |> take_while(prime => prime < bound)
                |> count()

        write_line("  {name} primes below {bound:N0}: {total:N0}")
    od
si

report("safe", is_safe, 35)
report("unsafe", prime => !is_safe(prime), 40)
